description: Save an item to the user's Grabblist. Creates a static snapshot — Grabblist does not monitor prices or auto-update data. Only include fields with values available from the source. Price is optional: omit it for videos and other things without a price. If no image is provided, the server attempts to fetch og:image automatically.

condition.description: Condition if applicable: New, Used, Refurbished, Used - Like New, Used - Good, Used - Fair

currency.description: Currency code of the price: USD, NZD, AUD, EUR, GBP, etc. Omit when there is no price.

image.description: Main image URL. Server auto-fetches og:image if not provided.

images.description: All image URLs found on the page

item_type.description: What kind of item: product (buy), rental (Airbnb), service (cleaning), course (Udemy), listing (classified), event (ticket), video (YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Vimeo…). If omitted, the server infers it from the platform (video sites → video, otherwise product).

original_price.description: Original price before discount (if on sale)

platform.description: Site domain name without TLD: amazon.com→"amazon", ebay.co.nz→"ebay", kiwiquads.co.nz→"kiwiquads"

posted_at.description: When the listing was originally posted (ISO 8601)

price.description: Price as a number (e.g. 99.99), taken from the page. Omit when the item has no price (videos, free content).

reason.description: Why this change was made (shown to user in change history)

name: add_item
